summary: fix(settings): strip PRF results on passkey registration and step-up
description:
Because:

- On registration and step-up, PRF outputs stayed off the wire only
  because JSON.stringify turns an ArrayBuffer into {}.
- The server reads prf.enabled at registration, so it must stay.

This commit:

- Makes stripPrfResults remove only prf.results and keep prf.enabled.
- Strips the credential before completePasskeyRegistration.
- Strips the stepUp assertion before completePasskeyVerification.

Closes FXA-14685
